hero.title: Shinkansen, ferry, car and flight: all booked
hero.description: Tickets handed over on arrival by Japan Experience. IC card for local transport, Toyota car for the Hokkaido loop.

cards.title: Outbound flight Luxembourg → Tokyo Haneda
cards.description: Booked through Japan Experience. Leaves Oct 23, lands at Haneda on Oct 24.

sections.title: Arrival at Haneda
items: Meet & greet after customs: agent with a sign showing your name - don't leave the airport without meeting them
Check the document envelope with the agent and sign (report anything missing on the spot)
Shared shuttle to the hotel: time emailed the evening before between 18:00 and 20:00 (check spam). 1 large bag per person
If the flight is more than 45 min late, the shuttle may leave without you: take a taxi, keep the receipt for a refund
Assistance: WhatsApp +81 90 3823 1949 (8:00-22:00)

sections.title: Documents
items: Passport
Japan Experience travel book

cards.title: Tokyo transport
cards.description: Metro and trains with the IC card handed over at the airport.

sections.title: IC card (Suica / Pasmo)
items: Handed over at the airport, loaded with JPY 2,000 (including a JPY 500 deposit)
Works on the metro, local trains, buses, monorail and for small purchases
Not valid on the Shinkansen, limited express trains or airport shuttles
Top-up and refund at stations

sections.title: Useful lines
items: JR Sobu (Ryogoku station) and the Toei Oedo metro
JR Yokosuka (Kinshicho → Kamakura) and the Enoden
Yurikamome (Shimbashi → Odaiba)

cards.title: Shinkansen Tokyo → Niigata
cards.description: Booked. Wed Oct 28, Toki 337, reserved seat in ordinary class.

sections.title: Times
items: 18:12: departure from Tokyo Station
20:07: arrival in Niigata
Be on the platform by 17:50 (at least 15 min before)

sections.title: Next
items: Taxi from Niigata station to the ferry terminal (~15 min, 4 km)
Be at the port by 21:00

cards.title: Ferry Niigata → Tomakomai
cards.description: Booked. Overnight crossing with a private cabin, via Akita, arriving at Tomakomai-Higashi port.

sections.title: Times
items: 22:30: departure from Niigata (Wed Oct 28)
Stop in Akita (05:05 - 06:15)
16:45: arrival in Tomakomai-Higashi (Thu Oct 29)
Be at the port 1h30 before

sections.title: Tomakomai-Higashi → Sapporo
items: Donan Bus connecting bus → JR Minami-Chitose station (~45 min, JPY 1,500, cash or PayPay)
JR Rapid Airport Minami-Chitose → Sapporo (~35 min)
The travel book says bus no. 24 to Tomakomai station: that is the West port access, not Tomakomai-Higashi

cards.title: Hokkaido regional trains
cards.description: No JR Pass needed: only Sapporo ↔ Otaru before the car.

sections.title: Useful lines
items: Sapporo ↔ Otaru (JR Hakodate Line, ~35 min)
Pay with the IC card or a ticket from the counter

cards.title: Toyota Rent a Car
cards.description: Booked and prepaid. From Sun Nov 1 09:00 to Sat Nov 7 19:00, Sapporo Ekimae branch.

sections.title: Pickup and return
items: Pickup Sun Nov 1 at 09:00: Toyota Rent a Car Sapporo Ekimae, Kita 5-jo Higashi 1-2-4, Chuo-ku
Return Sat Nov 7 before 19:00, same branch
Class S (C1), non-smoking, English GPS, double protection
ETC card: JPY 550 on site, tolls charged to your credit card on return

sections.title: Driving
items: Drive on the left, zero alcohol, no phone while driving
Early November: snow possible in the mountains, check for winter tyres
Emergencies: 110 (police), 119 (ambulance)

sections.title: Documents
items: Printed Toyota voucher (required)
Driving licence + official translation
Passport

links.label: Toyota Rent a Car Sapporo Ekimae (Maps)

cards.title: Flight Sapporo → Tokyo (JAL 508)
cards.description: Booked. Sun Nov 8, New Chitose 11:40 → Haneda 13:25.

sections.title: Transfers
items: Private shuttle hotel → New Chitose: time emailed the day before, by 17:30
Plan B: JR Rapid Airport from Sapporo station (37 min, IC card)
Be at the airport 1h30 to 2h before the flight
Shuttle Haneda → Hotel Resol Ikebukuro: time emailed the day before, by 17:30

cards.title: Return flight Tokyo Haneda → Luxembourg
cards.description: Booked. Tue Nov 10 at 22:45, via Frankfurt, arrives Nov 11 at 09:55.

sections.title: Flights
items: NH203: Tokyo Haneda 22:45 → Frankfurt
Connection in Frankfurt: 3h35
LH9528: Frankfurt → Luxembourg, arrives 09:55 (Wed Nov 11)

sections.title: Transfer
items: Shared shuttle hotel → Haneda: pickup ~3h30 before the flight (around 19:15)
Exact time emailed the evening before between 18:00 and 20:00 - be ready 10 min early
1 large bag per person
